summary.text: Treig Pronschinske is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly from District 29 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Chris Danou.
He owns and operates a construction company and is a volunteer firefighter in Mondovi.

paragraphs.text: Treig Pronschinske graduated from Memorial High School and earned a degree in construction management from Chippewa Valley Technical College.

He has served as a volunteer firefighter for the Mondovi Fire Department and as a member of the Mondovi Ambulance Commission, and has volunteered with the Mondovi Youth Baseball Association, Big Brothers & Big Sisters and Junior Achievement.
Pronschinske won general elections for Assembly District 92 in 2018, 2020 and 2022, and for District 29 in 2024, when he defeated Terry Schoonover.

For 2025-2026 he chairs the Sporting Heritage Committee, is vice-chair of the Criminal Justice and Public Safety and Consumer Protection committees, and also sits on the Agriculture, Forestry, Parks, and Outdoor Recreation, Housing and Real Estate, and Local Government committees.
